claims: WrestleMania 42 streams exclusively on ESPN Unlimited in the United States on April 18-19, 2026.
WrestleMania 42 is available via the ESPN app on smart TVs and devices.
Select cable providers like Spectrum, DirecTV, Hulu + Live TV include WrestleMania 42 in their packages.
Netflix will stream WrestleMania 42 in various countries including Canada, UK, Mexico, and others.
For the first time, the opening hour of each night of WrestleMania 42 will air on cable in the US.
The opening hour of Saturday night of WrestleMania 42 will air on ESPN2.
The opening hour of Sunday night of WrestleMania 42 will air on ESPN.
After the opening hour, WrestleMania 42 moves fully to the ESPN Unlimited app.
WrestleMania 42 main card starts at 6 p.m. ET / 3 p.m. PT on Saturday, April 18, 2026.
WrestleMania 42 main card starts at 6 p.m. ET / 3 p.m. PT on Sunday, April 19, 2026.
Live TV providers such as Hulu + Live TV, DirecTV, and Spectrum include ESPN Unlimited access.
WrestleMania 42 Kickoff is on Friday, April 17, 2026 at 5 p.m. ET / 2 p.m. PT.
WrestleMania 42 Night 1 main card begins on Saturday, April 18, 2026 at 6 p.m. ET / 3 p.m. PT.
WrestleMania 42 Night 2 main card begins on Sunday, April 19, 2026 at 6 p.m. ET / 3 p.m. PT.
